46202.short_term_rental_summary: Indianapolis has a short-term rental permit program. STR underwriting should assume registration, annual permitting, possible inspection, and local enforcement until the exact property is verified.
46202.rental_restriction_summary: No address-specific HOA, condo, deed, or subdivision documents were reviewed. These private restrictions can override an otherwise positive rental analysis and must be checked manually or placed in the knowledge bank.
